title: 09 · Growth and retention
description: New customers, referrals, cohorts, churn and the credits economy (05 §4 dashboard 09; owner W3-07).

links.title: Alerts
links.tooltip: Every alert links its runbook in docs/runbooks/

options.content: Cohorts are weekly (Monday, IST): customer cohort = week of the first completed order or linked POS sale; store cohort = week verified (05 §3). Each cell is the share of the cohort active N weeks later. Retention cells use `rollup_cohort_weekly`, recomputed daily.

panels.title: New customers per day by source
panels.description: Customer accounts created per day, by referral source (organic when no referral).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(u.created_at, '1d'), coalesce(r.source, 'organic') AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM users u LEFT JOIN referrals r ON r.referee_type = 'customer' AND r.referee_id = u.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.created_at) AND u.id IN (SELECT user_id FROM customer_profiles) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Referral signups and qualification
panels.description: Referrals created and how many of them qualified.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1d'), count(*) AS signups, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('qualified', 'rewarded')) AS qualified
FROM referrals WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Referral reward cost per qualified customer
panels.description: Credits paid from platform_marketing per qualified referral (1 credit = ₹1).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(referrer_credits + referee_credits)::float / nullif(count(*), 0) AS value
FROM referrals WHERE status IN ('qualified', 'rewarded') AND $__timeFilter(qualified_at)
SELECT avg((status IN ('qualified', 'rewarded'))::int) AS value FROM referrals WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Referral rejections by reason
panels.description: Why referrals were rejected (including rejected_same_device, D-13).

targets.rawSql: SELECT reject_reason, count(*) AS referrals FROM referrals WHERE status = 'rejected' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Customer transacting retention W0–W12
panels.description: Share (%) of each weekly customer cohort transacting N weeks later.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT cohort_week::text AS cohort, max(cohort_size) AS size,
max(CASE WHEN week_n = 0 THEN round(100.0 * ordering_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w0, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 1 THEN round(100.0 * ordering_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w1, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 2 THEN round(100.0 * ordering_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w2, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 3 THEN round(100.0 * ordering_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w3, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 4 THEN round(100.0 * ordering_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w4, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 5 THEN round(100.0 * ordering_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w5, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 6 THEN round(100.0 * ordering_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w6, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 7 THEN round(100.0 * ordering_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w7, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 8 THEN round(100.0 * ordering_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w8, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 9 THEN round(100.0 * ordering_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w9, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 10 THEN round(100.0 * ordering_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w10, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 11 THEN round(100.0 * ordering_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w11, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 12 THEN round(100.0 * ordering_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w12
FROM rollup_cohort_weekly WHERE kind = 'customer' GROUP BY cohort_week ORDER BY cohort_week DESC

panels.title: Store active retention W0–W12
panels.description: Share (%) of each weekly store cohort active N weeks later.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT cohort_week::text AS cohort, max(cohort_size) AS size,
max(CASE WHEN week_n = 0 THEN round(100.0 * active_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w0, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 1 THEN round(100.0 * active_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w1, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 2 THEN round(100.0 * active_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w2, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 3 THEN round(100.0 * active_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w3, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 4 THEN round(100.0 * active_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w4, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 5 THEN round(100.0 * active_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w5, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 6 THEN round(100.0 * active_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w6, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 7 THEN round(100.0 * active_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w7, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 8 THEN round(100.0 * active_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w8, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 9 THEN round(100.0 * active_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w9, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 10 THEN round(100.0 * active_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w10, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 11 THEN round(100.0 * active_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w11, max(CASE WHEN week_n = 12 THEN round(100.0 * active_count / nullif(cohort_size, 0)) END) AS w12
FROM rollup_cohort_weekly WHERE kind = 'store' GROUP BY cohort_week ORDER BY cohort_week DESC

panels.title: App retention D1 / D7 / D30
panels.description: Customers first seen N days earlier who opened the app on this day (05 §3).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS time, ret_d1_back::float / nullif(ret_d1_base, 0) AS d1, ret_d7_back::float / nullif(ret_d7_base, 0) AS d7,
       ret_d30_back::float / nullif(ret_d30_base, 0) AS d30
FROM rollup_daily_platform WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Churned (active 30–60 d ago, none since)
panels.description: Customers whose last app open was 30–60 days ago.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM (SELECT actor_id FROM v_metric_app_opens WHERE app = 'customer' GROUP BY actor_id
  HAVING max(occurred_at) < now() - interval '30 days' AND max(occurred_at) >= now() - interval '60 days') x

panels.title: Resurrected (back this week after 30 d away)
panels.description: Customers who opened the app this week after more than 30 days away.

targets.rawSql:
WITH o AS (SELECT actor_id, occurred_at, lag(occurred_at) OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY occurred_at) AS prev FROM v_metric_app_opens WHERE app = 'customer')
SELECT count(DISTINCT actor_id) AS value FROM o WHERE occurred_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND prev < occurred_at - interval '30 days'

panels.title: Credits issued, spent, expired per day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS time, credits_issued AS issued, credits_spent AS spent, credits_expired AS expired
FROM rollup_daily_platform WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Credits issued by kind (range)
panels.description: Cashback, referral and adjustment credits into customer wallets.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.kind, sum(e.amount) AS credits FROM ledger_transactions t JOIN ledger_entries e ON e.transaction_id = t.id
JOIN ledger_accounts a ON a.id = e.account_id AND a.kind = 'customer_wallet'
WHERE e.amount > 0 AND t.kind IN ('cashback', 'referral_reward', 'admin_adjustment') AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Outstanding liability
panels.description: Σ customer wallets + held credits right now.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(balance), 0) AS value FROM account_balances WHERE kind IN ('customer_wallet', 'customer_held')
SELECT sum(credits_expired)::float / nullif(sum(credits_issued), 0) AS value FROM rollup_daily_platform WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
